svg.aria-label: A marble run that follows one design change from idea to rule: a marble leaves the crazy-prototype hopper, passes iterate-it, whip-it and break-it on the UI work run, drops through the git push trap door under the Nudge, is recorded by design-delta, and at five Deltas design-lessons tips out a design rule that a lift carries back up. design-morph films an old page becoming a new one.
